rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded Day 5 blastocyst with thinned zona, compact ICM, and cohesive TE consistent with the reported 3AA; appropriately notes limits of single-image assessment, though it is not highly image-specific.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve, endometrium, male factor, and especially the significance of three prior failed IVF cycles in modifying prognosis despite good embryo morphology.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to favorable and unfavorable factors; only minor uncertainty from broad ranges and dependence on missing prior-cycle details.

Recommendations are well aligned with standard IVF practice: SET for a good-quality blastocyst in a 33-year-old, attention to transfer technique and luteal support, selective uterine/male-factor workup, cautious discussion of PGT-A, and avoidance of low-evidence add-ons.

Provides clear practical next steps for the current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, transfer optimization, progesterone review, uterine cavity assessment, sperm DNA fragmentation consideration, and review of prior cycle details.
